import urllib.request
import json

# NCBI Gene 137970
url = "https://eutils.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/entrez/eutils/esummary.fcgi?db=gene&id=137970&retmode=json"
with urllib.request.urlopen(url) as response:
    gene_data = json.loads(response.read().decode())
    print("NCBI Gene Summary:", gene_data['result']['137970']['name'], gene_data['result']['137970']['description'])
